ns2:subject.subjectComment: NOTE: Students considering enrollment in Military Science, Naval Science, or Air Force Aerospace Studies courses should be aware that University policy prohibits discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation; students may enroll in these courses regardless of sexual orientation.
